# Rena Farm

> Integrated livestock and fodder farm in Kajiado Central, Kenya.
> 140 acres, established 2018. Operated by Rena Global Merchants Ltd.

Rena Farm breeds and sells Dorper sheep, Friesian dairy cattle, Sahiwal beef
cattle, Gala goats and improved kienyeji poultry. It grows and processes its own
fodder on roughly 40 of its 140 acres: Boma Rhodes hay, Super Napier, Lucerne,
Brachiaria and yellow maize, made into hay, silage and pellets on the farm.

Location: Kenya Marble Quarry Road, Kajiado Central, Kenya (-1.918604, 36.737787)
Distance: about 105 km from Nairobi CBD
Delivery: Kajiado County, Nairobi and surrounding areas
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 07:00-18:00 EAT
Contact: info@renafarm.co.ke | +254 724 980 372 | +254 715 438 010
